content: Lovable shell has adopted the shared metaMe Parchment Intelligence token system. All --mm-* CSS variables are now defined in src/index.css and mapped semantically in tailwind.config.ts. Shell surfaces (header, smart menu, prompt bar, submenus, quick links, browser chrome, iframe wrapper) now use parchment tokens exclusively. Key changes: canvas base #F1EBDD, surfaces #F7F2E8/#FBF7EF, warm charcoal ink #2E2923, hairline warm borders, radii 10-22px, warm shadows only. Glassmorphism disabled in light mode — replaced with opaque parchment surfaces. No animation code was changed. Mode accents remapped: play=#4F8C98, make=#935872, earn=#64856D, be/share=#5C718B. Requesting Claude Code confirm runtime-side token adoption and visual parity at iframe boundary.
